text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's just before the autumn Tenno Sho,
and
Satono Diamond is heading into her
first fall G1
race.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Stay sharp, Dia! It's the Kikuka Sho, the
last of the Triple Crown races. It's the
moment of truth...
but also your big
chance!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I know. I remember how you ran in it last
year,
Kita. You were so determined to
see it through to
the very end...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I can see the path clearly because you
showed me
the way. I won't let even the
worst of luck stop me
this time!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I am Satono Diamond! I was born to
make the
Satonos' dream a reality!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And, on that day...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: ...history was rewritten.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's done it! Satono Diamond has won
the race!
Bad luck's got nothing on her!
She's finally
claimed a G1 victory!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The name of the prominent Satono
Group has
been immortalized in racing
history!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all for your support. At long
last, I was able to make a meaningful
contribution to the
world of
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Satono will continue to be your valued
partner on
and off the racecourse, for
racing, support aid,
and business.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond absolutely nails the
winner's interview and carries her mantle
as the representative of the Satono
Group with great
dignity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That night...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Awww yeah! Yes! YAHOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia, Dia! You did it! YOU REALLY DID
IT!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You won a G1 race! You've dreamt of
doing that
for so long, and you finally
did it! You won the
Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We're celebrating tonight! No, one night
won't be
nearly enough! Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's even happier for her than if she
won herself. Her cheers are more akin to
shrieks of delight, to
be honest.
Meanwhile...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond has maintained her
dignified
demeanor this whole time, but
she hasn't said a
word. Then...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Sniff... Hic...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Waaah!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I wooon, I did it... I actually won...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
But I lost so many races... I felt so bad
about how
pathetic and useless I was...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
But today, I won! I won, Kita! Trainer! I
wooon!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia is... crying? She's... She's really
crying...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Sniffle! DIAAAAAA!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two embrace each other tightly,
spirits
uniting as one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bound by destiny, they fought together
across seasons, until finally, Satono
Diamond achieved
the dream she had
long held onto.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the stage shifts to the autumn
Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Well, hello, hello! ♪ It's your fav
Umadol, Falco,
with today's weather!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, the skies over the autumn
Tenno Sho
are...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
What in the world?! What's the gray
swirly thing in the sky?! Is that a
typhoon?! The stage wouldn't
last two
minutes if it comes this way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: SSH! WHOOOOOSH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon isn't exaggerating for
views. This is the worst weather ever
recorded for the autumn Tenno Sho.
We're in the middle of a literal 
maelstrom.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I leave the stands to inspect the track,
but the whole thing is obscured in a
rainy haze. The
runners will have near
zero visibility.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I mutter the words to myself, dismayed
at the
sight before me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the conditions might be really
bad, but...
I have to do this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I glance over and find Kitasan Black
looking not
at the track, but in a
completely different
direction.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Do you see all the fans? They took the
time to come out here, but look how
cold they are.
They're shivering like
mad.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Not a single one of them is smiling.
They're
gritting their teeth just so they
won't chatter...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Even so, they came. They're here to see
me race.
And if that's what they're here
for...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Then that's what I'll give them! I'll give
them a
race to remember, bad weather
or not!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the fans braving the violent storm
just for
the sake of watching her run sets
Kitasan Black's
heart ablaze.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia fulfilled her dream of winning a G1
race. But I
still haven't made mine a
reality...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
My dream is to make everyone smile!
And if I
want to grant that wish, then I'll
have to pass this
trial with flying colors!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still, the track looks like a real mess.
How should I even run in that muddy
disaster so that the crowd
will feel
entertained and smile?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unless we show them a truly
extraordinary race, it'll be near
impossible to keep the fans happy in
a
torrential downpour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's one thing that can possibly
satisfy and entertain the crowd in such
bad conditions, and
only Kitasan Black is
capable of pulling it off.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You mean, just sprint through
everything? Even
the potholes and mud
swamps?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Knowing Kitasan Black, she might really
be strong
enough to brute force her way
through even the
worst stretches.
choice_data_list: Yeah, charge right in without fear!
Yeah, charge right in without fear!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In fact, she might be the only one who
can power through the terrible track
conditions with her
natural doggedness
and grab victory!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'll take your word for it! I'm
not gonna
shy away from puddles or the
inner lane, even if
it's all churned up!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If Dia can break her curse, then I can
beat this
typhoon! This is for the fans!
